messages.subject: shinyapps.io now supports R 3.1.3
parts:
Hello all, 
As of this morning, we have added support for R 3.1.3.  If you had upgraded your local machine to R 3.1.3 and couldn't deploy yesterday or the day before, please give it a spin and let us know if you have any issues. 

The shinyapps.io team
